items.description: CueFrame is a deterministic video composition API: you write the edit as data (e.g. JSON) and CueFrame renders it; the same input always renders the same video, and changing one line changes only that one thing.
Users can author their own components, including native 3D scenes that arrange their images and videos, rendered by the same API; CueFrame is usable over MCP, CLI and REST.
Main documentation hub covering composing video over MCP, CLI and REST

Public MCP server (Streamable HTTP); initialize and tools/list are free, data operations require payment (x402 pay-per-call)
